name: Wild Abandon
s: In the haze of a midlife crisis, an architect begins living a double life as a punk while members of his family lead their own crisis-ridden lives.

paragraphs.text: Wild Abandon () is a 2022 Turkish television series starring Öner Erkan, Haluk Bilginer and Songül Öden. The show was released on Netflix on 30 March 2022.
